text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 to the report (December 18, 2025) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services, as amended by: a. replacing "Seventeenth Street" with "Sixteenth Street" under the "Location" column in Table 1 so that it now reads: "Sixteenth Street, west side, between a point 22 metres north of Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 5.5 metres further north." 2. Amended parking regulations required in Chapter 950, as generally described in Attachment 2 - Technical Amendments to the report (December 18, 2025) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
